fields.description: Erstes Listenelement: event_intervals (max. 4). Danach je Monitor path, conditions, name, interval, severity (WARNING|CRITICAL). Verzeichnispfade enden mit /
fields.example:
- event_intervals:
    - interval_1: 300
    - interval_2: 3600
- path: '/var/log/app/'
  conditions:
    - 'FILE_COUNT > 100'
  name: 'app-logdir'
  interval: 'interval_1'
  severity: 'WARNING'
